prompt.zh-TW: 北風單車行把全部存貨賒銷給一家租車公司，售價 {{money:e1.price}}，貨款下個月才收。損益表與資產負債表已經算好，請填出現金流量表起算的稅前淨利，讓步驟②（勾稽點 A）亮綠燈。
prompt.en: North Wind Cycles sells all its inventory on credit to a bike-hire company for {{money:e1.price}}, with payment due next month. The income statement and balance sheet are done; fill in the profit before tax that the statement of cash flows starts from, so that step 2 (check A) turns green.

explanation.zh-TW: 步驟②只是把損益表的稅前淨利 {{money:expected.t1.after}} 原封不動抄到現金流量表的第一列，所以答案是 {{money:expected.t2.after}}。雖然一毛錢都還沒收到（現金仍是 {{money:expected.t3.after}}），稅前淨利已經包含這筆賒銷的毛利。之後現金流量表會在「銷貨債權增加(-)」減掉整筆還沒收到的 {{money:e1.price}}，並在「存貨增加(-)」這一列以正數加回賣掉的存貨成本 {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}}，營業活動的現金流量總計剛好是零，和現金沒有變動一致。
explanation.en: Step 2 simply copies profit before tax of {{money:expected.t1.after}} from the income statement to the first line of the statement of cash flows, so the answer is {{money:expected.t2.after}}. Even though not a cent has been received yet (cash is still {{money:expected.t3.after}}), profit before tax already includes the gross profit on this credit sale. Further down, the statement of cash flows deducts the whole uncollected {{money:e1.price}} on the ‘increase in trade receivables (-)’ line and adds back the {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}} cost of the inventory sold, as a positive figure, on the ‘increase in inventories (-)’ line, so net cash from operating activities comes to exactly zero, in line with the unchanged cash balance.
